newsitem.title: MACEDONIA: MACEDONIA STOCK TURNOVER, VOLUME FALL.
newsitem.headline: MACEDONIA STOCK TURNOVER, VOLUME FALL.

text.p: Turnover fell to 538,350 denars at Tuesday's session of the Macedonian Stock Exchange from 1.814 million denars on Thursday as only one company traded, the exchange said.

Alkaloid joint stock company sold 555 shares at 970 denars, unchanged from Thursday's close and below par of 2,425 denars. Traded volume was 1,870 shares at Thursday's session when only Alkaloid stocks traded.
Listed companies trade in two floor sessions. The exchange trades on Tuesday and Thursday.
